mapper.sql: SELECT rv.id, rv.book_id, rv.reader_id, rv.status, rv.created_at, rv.ready_at, rv.hold_until, r.name AS reader_name FROM reservations rv JOIN readers r ON r.id = rv.reader_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (book_id, reader_id, status) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{readerId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'READY')
SELECT id, book_id, reader_id, status, created_at, ready_at, hold_until FROM reservations WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
WHERE rv.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY rv.created_at ASC, rv.id ASC
SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM reservations WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'READY') GROUP BY book_id ORDER BY book_id
